2317-2438-6664-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

5742-5743-6441-8242.description:
Activate Songbird by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Songbird ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1110-7839-8168.description:
Cast Draconic Visitor by paying {3}{R}{R}.
When Draconic Visitor enters, Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating a number of 5/5 Dragon creature tokens with flying due to Draconic Visitor. 
When the Dragons enter, Terror of the Peaks triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, dealing damage to Smaug.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-1659-2443-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-1659-2443-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-6754-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

851-3129-6664-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3861-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

372-673-1621.manaNeeded: {5}{U}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-673-1621.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Planar Incision by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Wispweaver Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Wispweaver Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wispweaver Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Wispweaver Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1849-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

567-1594-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul's Attendant trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
567-1594-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1580-2292-4871-6112.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7315-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and High Score.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1451-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Pyreheart Wolf
When Pyreheart Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Pyreheart Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
997-1451-6972.notes: If Pyreheart Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

224-1362-1772-3875.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

240-413-5470-6965.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
When the Egg enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 3.

856-4779-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2302-2584-3490-4050-4369.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2302-2584-3490-4050-4369.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to an opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature, adding one mana of any colour.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

955-1563-3899-6441.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-6155.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Arid Mesa.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3585-6155.description:
Fetch a land using Arid Mesa.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-1329-1482-4359.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2773-4186-6919.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
2773-4186-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Scurry Oak.
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing damage to Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.

1836-4423-6618-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control at least three Islands.
1836-4423-6618-6650.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Relm's Sketching from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Activate the original Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 4.

136-4067-5527-6281.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
136-4067-5527-6281.description:
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Cadaver Imp.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Cadaver Imp that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Cadaver Imp token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cadaver Imp from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least two loyalty counters on it

654-1445-2366-4094-6413.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
654-1445-2366-4094-6413.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding Dryad Arbor.
Green Goblin's second ability triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers twice, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card.
Green Goblin's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a Goblin you control.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter and without summoning sickness
with a fade counter on it

3143-4613-4704-4762.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3143-4613-4704-4762.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and a fade counter on Saproling Burst.
Activate Saproling Burst by removing a fade counter from it, creating a Saproling creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

5226-5365-5445.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Lonis.
5226-5365-5445.description:
Activate Lithatog's first ability by sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis' second ability and Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Tarrian's Soulcleaver trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lonis.
Lonis' first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the Lithatog ability from step 1, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2438-3451-4191-4784.description:
Cast Augusta from your hand by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Augusta.
When Augusta dies, Death's Oasis triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Plargg from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

121-1167-4502.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target player during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, cast Game of Chaos by paying {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Game of Chaos, choosing to continue flipping a coin until the opponent loses the flip and the amount of life wagered is greater than or equal to the opponent's life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1978-3371-5149.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Power Artifact attached to Voltaic Construct.
1978-3371-5149.description:
Activate Codie by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {1}, untapping Codie.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.

2803-3263-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Mark of Sakiko attached to a creature with power seven or greater that can attack this turn, and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Hellkite Charger cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2803-3263-3398.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger and the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached as attackers.
Hellkite Charge triggers, causing you to pay {7} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Mark of Sakiko attached.
The creature triggers, adding at least {7}.
Repeat each combat phase.
If the creature with Mark of Sakiko attached has power eight or greater, this combo will net infinite mana.

933-1494-2744-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr creature tokens.
The Myr tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade four times.
Resolve all Cathars' Crusade triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

15-643-1339-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
15-643-1339-4050.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1524-2724-3987.notablePrerequisites: Ilharg does not have summoning sickness.
1524-2724-3987.description:
Attack with Ilharg.
Ilharg's attack trigger triggers, putting Wormfang Manta onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Wormfang Manta is returned to your hand.
This triggers its LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
